CONTROL NETWORK (EtherNet/IP star, VLAN per area)
WS-203 ICS685s micro scale · TCP SICS
BF-306 bag filler weigh controller · EtherNet/IP
WS-206A Zebra ZT411 weigh room · TCP 9100 ZPL
NW-501 Spee-Dee net weigher PLC · EtherNet/IP
PA-414 ZE511 print engine · TCP 9100 ZPL
SRV-611 MES / line manager server · OPC UA client, EtherNet/IP (pycomm3), SICS, ZPL

WS-206B Zebra ZT411 blending · TCP 9100 ZPL
FW-1 plant firewall to office / internet (one-way history push) · routed
1. Motor FLA from NEC Table 430.250 at 460 V; conductors sized at 125% FLA, 75 °C column.
2. Feeder breaker = (125% of largest motor + sum of others) x 1.25, next standard size; confirm in stamped design.
3. OEM machines arrive with their own panels; F-2xx feeders end at their disconnects.
4. Dust collector fan and isolation valve interlock with blending (stop on vent burst).
5. Panels CP-300/CP-400 are SS Type 4X; dry-clean area, no washdown hoses.
6. A licensed electrical engineer stamps the final design (NEC 2023, NFPA 79 for machines).
